title: Bucket Hard Delete Pause Configuration
summary: Cloud Storage buckets now support a `hardDeletePause` configuration within their `softDeletePolicy`. This new setting allows you to temporarily prevent permanent deletion of soft-deleted objects.
details: The `Bucket` schema has been extended with a new `softDeletePolicy.hardDeletePause` object. This configuration includes an `enabled` boolean property to activate or deactivate the pause, and an `effectiveTime` string (RFC 3339 format) indicating when the pause became active. This provides more granular control over data retention and recovery for soft-deleted objects.
